FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Trendy Threads Boutique specializes in retail clothing and apparel, offering a curated selection of trending styles for women, men, and children. Our operations involve sourcing high-quality garments from reputable suppliers, with a strong emphasis on customer service and personalized shopping experiences. We maintain a diverse inventory, ensuring we stay within acceptable limits while minimizing exposure to theft. Our store operates primarily as a physical retail space, with online sales accounting for less than 75% of total revenue, thus reducing our cyber and fulfillment risks. We also implement robust inventory management practices, utilizing an advanced point-of-sale system to track sales and stock levels efficiently. With a commitment to compliance with all safety regulations, labor laws, and consumer protection standards, Trendy Threads Boutique focuses on maintaining a safe and welcoming environment for all customers and staff.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, Trendy Threads Boutique experienced a theft resulting in a loss of $15,000, with the case currently under investigation by local authorities. Additionally, on 04/10/2023, water damage from a burst pipe caused an estimated loss of $10,000, which has been resolved, and repairs are complete.
